name: Varifocal Mirror Display
definition: A display system that eliminates the need for mental reconstruction by displaying the entire stack of tomographic images as a 3D image using a vibrating mirror with variable focal length optics.
summary: The Varifocal Mirror Display creates true 3D images by reflecting 2D frames from a vibrating, variable-focal-length mirror, distinguishing itself from other methods by using audio-driven deformation rather than mechanical rotation or beam scanning.
